summary: ITER 8 verification of two Ambassadors/Referrals fixes from iter6 — BOTH FIXES CONFIRMED WORKING. (1) captureIncomingReferral rewrite in /app/frontend/src/referrals.ts now correctly stores exactly `"user_XXXXXX"` (JSON-quoted by AsyncStorage-web) with NO whitespace and NO leaked URL fragment. New parseParam regex `[?#&]${key}=([^&#\s]+)` + firstMatch(separateCandidates) + REF_VALIDATOR `/^user_[a-f0-9]{6,32}$/i` all working as designed. Malformed URLs (%20hax%20) and non-hex ids (user_nonexistent999) are correctly rejected client-side. (2) Backend GET /api/referrals/poster.png now accepts `?t=<session_token>` as an alternative to Authorization header (server.py:1443-1460) — verified via new pytest suite: missing token=401, header=200 PNG, ?t=valid=200 PNG (96 KB, `\x89PNG` magic), ?t=bogus=401, ?t=expired(deleted-session)=401. Frontend AmbassadorsCard.openPoster() resolves referralPosterUrlWithToken() before opening the modal, so <Image src={...?t=<token>}> renders successfully (HTTP 200, image/png, naturalWidth=1080). Full E2E attribution flow verified: (a) `/?ref=user_78caf7d13f49` → localStorage stores `"user_78caf7d13f49"`; (b) fresh register → pending_ref consumed (null); (c) inviter's /referrals/mine now shows pending=1 with the new invitee, confirming invited_by_user_id was set correctly on the backend. Cache-Control emitted by the backend as `private, max-age=300` (verified via direct localhost curl); the public ingress/Cloudflare layer overrides it to `no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate` — this is infra, not a code issue. No new bugs found. 12/12 new pytest cases pass. Cosmetic RN-web console warnings unchanged (shadow*, pointerEvents deprecations).

minor.issue: Cache-Control emitted by backend as `private, max-age=300` is overridden by the ingress/Cloudflare layer to `no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate` when accessed via the public URL. Direct backend hit (localhost:8001) preserves the intended header. Non-blocking — image still returns 200 image/png, but per-user caching won't take effect at the CDN. Consider disabling the ingress-level override, or accept the trade-off.

issues: Cosmetic warnings persist (not blockers): 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow); props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Same as iter5/iter6/iter7.

action_items: OPTIONAL / LOW — Investigate the ingress Cache-Control override on /api/referrals/poster.png (backend emits `private, max-age=300` correctly; the platform proxy rewrites it). Not a code fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix #1 (referrals.ts) is clean and defensive: parseParam explicitly excludes whitespace via `[^&#\s]+`, firstMatch parses search/hash/href separately (no concatenation), REF_VALIDATOR gates both writes AND reads (consumePendingReferral/peekPendingReferral drop stale malformed values). Backend _attach_inviter (server.py) already ignores unknown refs — belt-and-suspenders.

Fix #2 (poster.png ?t=) mirrors the existing certificates pattern (/api/certificates/{module_id}?t=). Header still takes priority over query when both are present. AmbassadorsCard shows an ActivityIndicator while awaiting the token — no broken image flash. referralPosterUrlWithToken correctly url-encodes the token.

REF_VALIDATOR `/^user_[a-f0-9]{6,32}$/i` matches the backend user_id format (`user_` + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]). If backend user_id format ever changes to include non-hex chars, this validator must be updated in lockstep — flag for reviewers.
